strings.{0} 님과의 상담에 녹음을 붙입니다. 적어 둔 내용은 그대로 두고 받아: Attaches a recording to the consultation with {0}. Your notes stay as they are; a transcript, summary, and task suggestions are added.
strings.고객 번호를 넣으면 그 연락처의 방문 상담으로 남습니다. 비워 두면 연결: Enter the client's number to log it as an in-person consultation for that contact. If left blank, link a contact later from Awaiting link.
strings.녹음 파일 고르기 (m4a, mp3, wav 등): Choose a recording file (m4a, mp3, wav, etc.)
Uploading the recording. Transcription and analysis follow once it's uploaded.
Uploading the recording. You can track progress in the table.
Couldn't upload the recording. Please upload it again.
Couldn't re-analyze. Please try again shortly.
Re-analyzing. This will update automatically when done.
strings.등록된 번호면 그 연락처에 자동으로 연결됩니다. 갤럭시 기본 녹음 파일은: Registered numbers are linked to their contact automatically. For Galaxy's built-in recorder, the number and time are filled in from the file name.
strings.매물 가격을 바꾸고 오늘 확인한 것으로 기록합니다. 가격 이력에 남습니다: Updates the listing price and records it as verified today. The change is kept in the price history.
Closes the match. Closed matches drop off the active list.
After transcription and analysis, a consultation log is saved and tasks and events are suggested.
strings.사무실 전화로 받고 건 통화가 시간 순서로 남습니다. 녹음과 상담 기록은: Calls made and received on the office phone are listed in time order. Recordings and consultation logs are in Consultations.
Adds it as a new requirement.
strings.아직 남은 통화가 없습니다. 사무실 전화가 연결되면 받고 건 통화가 여기: No calls yet. Once the office phone is connected, incoming and outgoing calls will appear here.
This call hasn't been analyzed yet.
strings.연락처를 등록하고 통화 기록에 연결했습니다: Contact added and linked to the call
Records it as verified with the owner today. The price stays the same.
strings.원문을 듣고 확인하세요: Listen to the recording to check
Processing audio. This will update automatically when done.
strings.의뢰를 종료합니다. 매물이 진행 목록에서 빠지고 걸려 있던 매칭도 영향을: Closes the request. The listing drops off the active list, and any linked matches are affected.
strings.이 고객의 희망 조건과 매물을 매칭으로 묶습니다. 희망매물 화면에 새 줄: Links this client's requirement and the listing as a match. A new row appears on the Wanted screen.
Adds this number as a new contact and links it to the call.
Search for a contact to link this call to.
strings.지금 값을 바꿉니다 — 확인 후 체크: Overwrites the current value — check to confirm
strings.지금 저장된 값을 불러오지 못해 견줄 수 없습니다. 체크한 항목은 저장된: Couldn't load the current saved values to compare. Checked fields overwrite the saved values, so choose them yourself.
Check the current saved values. Nothing has been applied yet.
Analyzing the call. A consultation log and suggestions will appear when done.
strings.통화 내용을 상담 기록으로 저장합니다. 저장 후 상담기록 페이지에서 매물: Saves the call as a consultation log. After saving, you can link it to listings and matches on the Consultations page.
Link the caller's contact to apply this.
Summarize what was discussed on the call.
Only one recording can be attached per consultation.
strings.AI 요약과 대화 내용이 자동으로 채워집니다. 저장 전에 수정할 수 있습: The AI summary and transcript are filled in automatically. You can edit them before saving.
strings.AI 제안 · 통화에서 나온 다음 일: AI suggestions · Next steps from the call
strings.AI가 통화 내용에서 골라낸 것입니다. 받아쓰기는 숫자·이름을 틀릴 수: Picked out by AI from the call. Transcripts can get numbers and names wrong — review them and create only what you need.
